notes.title: SkyBoats Patch 1.03 – “Breezy Mode v2.0” is LIVE
notes.notes:
Breezy Mode v2.0 is here!

Blog Post: http://blog.braingoodgames.com/2017/05/25/skyboats-patch-1-03-breezy-mode-v2-0-is-live/

Patch Notes:
-Rank is now adjusted after 1 win or 1 loss (previously 1 win 2 losses)
-Fixed bug with used goods not refreshing in Ranked mode
-Fixed bug with Compass & a good in the cargo hold

HUGE overhaul to Breezy Mode
This version is fast-playing and more streamlined! Can't wait for you guys to try it out. I lost 3-4 hours yesterday "playtesting".

Current Rules Changes From Ranked Mode:

-Goods value only based on quantity for first round (random every round thereafter)-You can no longer sell undemanded goods
-Boats down to 2 (may go back up to 3 at higher ranks)
-Reduced board size
-Removed gold completely
-Maps now cost 1vp (one available at each city/round)
-Upgrades are free at 2/3 cities per round
-Removed refuel from shop
-Contracts are now 3 of the same good
-Contracts are not rerolled each round and are for 3 of the same good
-Moving out of cities does not cost fuel
-All boats refuel up to full each turn
-Wind meter max is now 6 (+1 when 5+ Wind Meter)
-Wind Meter goes to 0 at end of turn
-2 Goods are randomly spawned at the start of each round
-Modified Carrot pattern
-You can now pick up items mid-glide
-Added "goods" abilities to boats as default upgrades
-Reworked a couple upgrades slightly
-Goods can freely be dropped and picked back up in unused holds

notes.notes:

Solar Settlers is a card-driven space exploration strategy game set in the far future. Our sun is on the verge of collapse and so mankind has taken to the stars aboard colony ships to seek out a new home. You are the caretaker of one such ship, and must carefully manage the planets you find, technology cards you posses and fellow colonists as they gradually awaken from a long cryo-sleep in order to scratch out a new cradle for humanity.

notes.title: SkyBoats Patch 1.01 "Key to the SkyCity"
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26006631/3228a4735d09be5512f656607a2e9102e28919cd.png[/img]

Update 1.01 is live on Steam! It features a new unlock system that advances every time you complete a match, win or lose! There are also two new SkyBoats and a new upgrade to unlock!

Full feature list:

-Added unlock system
-Added two new boats (“Galleon” and “Paddleboat”)
-Added Compass upgrade
-Added practice mode (in settings)
-Added a few FAQ tips after you win or lose your second match
-Added city preview pane to top right of screen that shows city demands
-Fixed “Asparagus” typo in tutorial
-Set target framerate to 60

As always, we can’t wait to hear what you think! Hope you enjoy SkyBoats “Key to the SkyCity”! Send any feedback, bugs or suggestions to braingoodgames (at) gmail (dot) com

notes.title: 1.00c Update Live!
notes.notes:
-Flip now allows you to flip 2 tiles
-Transmute now gives 3g and 1VP
-Teleporter now refreshes destination cargo hold
-Manufacture now always spawns a good not among the city good regions
-Reworked upgrade tiers
-SkyBoat balance number tweaks
-Added option to display boat "class names" in settings
-Round limit now has a minimum of 5
-Fixed bug with marketplace city VP value display
-Map goods are refreshed at end of turn
-Fullscreen and windowed mode now both allow you to place wind in the same places (used to be able to place further offscreen in fullscreen)
-Refuel now costs 1 wind meter per glide of the purchasing boat

As always, let me know if there are any bugs or if you have any suggestions. Thanks for all the support :).
